## Summary

Describe the routing, compatibility, installer, documentation, or test change.

## Why

What problem does this solve? Include evidence for token/latency/model claims when applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `python scripts/doctor.py --source-tree .`
- [ ] Documentation updated if behavior changed
- [ ] No credentials/private repository content included

## Efficiency / quality impact

Explain expected impact on correctness, total tokens, elapsed time, retries, and agent count. Use "not measured" where appropriate instead of guessing.

## Compatibility

List affected Codex/model versions or say "none known".
